seo.title: AI Platform | After-Hours AI, No-Touch CRM, Magic Listings & Attribution
seo.description: The AI platform under everything Buzznerd builds: AI Assistant answers leads after hours, No-Touch CRM hands reps a ranked morning digest, Magic Flow builds listings from photos, and attribution traces every channel to the sold unit.

sections.headline: AI that works your leads while you sleep.
sections.subheadline: Four connected systems under everything Buzznerd builds: AI answers buyers after hours, your reps get a ranked morning digest instead of CRM filing, listings build themselves from photos, and every sale traces back to the channel that drove it.

sections.title: Every lead answered — even at 11:48 PM.
sections.body: When your team is offline, AI answers inbound texts, emails, and web chats on the same channel the buyer used — then hands your rep a warm briefing when they sign in.
bullets: Same-channel replies — SMS, email, and web chat
Warm-handoff brief: what was asked, answered, and still owed
Hard guardrails — pricing and trade values stay human-only

sections.title: Follow-up without the filing.
sections.body: Assembled overnight from every conversation, storefront visit, and price change: a ranked digest of the few things actually worth your rep's time — in their inbox at 7:00 AM. Nothing to log, nothing to file. Act on it or dismiss it; we track the rest.
bullets: Ranked by real buying signals, not recency
Every card explains WHY it's on the list
Plays nice with the CRM you already run

sections.title: Photos in. Full listing out.
sections.body: Snap a unit on the lot and AI builds the entire product page in one read — title, description, specs, FAQs, and best-for tags. You confirm what it found and set the price; it suggests a range from comparable units, but never prices for you.
bullets: One photo read builds every section of the page
AI proposes, you confirm — nothing publishes unchecked
Price guidance from comps — the price stays yours

sections.title: Every sale traced to its channel.
sections.body: Most tools stop at the lead. Buzznerd tags every share, call, and inquiry with its channel and closes the loop at the sale — so you know which marketing moves metal, not just which gets clicks.
bullets: One channel taxonomy across shares, leads, and sales
Tracked phone numbers — calls count, not just clicks
Per-channel visitors → leads → sold units, per listing

items.title: Money stays human
items.body: The AI never quotes prices, promises delivery, or values a trade. Those are locked to your people, always.

items.title: Honest by design
items.body: AI actions are marked as AI. Buyers always know whether they're talking to your assistant or your salesperson.

items.title: Your data, your dealership
items.body: Conversations, leads, and sale outcomes belong to your dealership — not a rep's personal phone.

items.question: What is the Buzznerd AI Platform?
items.answer: The AI under everything Buzznerd builds — the AI Assistant answers leads after hours, No-Touch CRM hands reps a ranked morning digest, Magic Flow builds listings from photos, and attribution traces every channel to the sold unit.

items.question: Does the AI Assistant replace my salespeople?
items.answer: No. It covers inbound questions when no salesperson is available and reads each buyer's intent and readiness, then hands your team a warm brief. Prices, delivery promises, and trade values always stay human-only.

items.question: What is the No-Touch CRM?
items.answer: A ranked morning digest — not a data-entry CRM. It assembles your hottest follow-ups overnight with replies pre-drafted, so reps act instead of filing. It also plays nice with the CRM you already run.

items.question: How fast can Magic Flow list a unit?
items.answer: About a minute. Snap photos on the lot and Magic Flow builds the title, description, specs, and FAQs. You confirm what it found and set the price — including comp-based price guidance.

items.question: Can I see which marketing channel actually sells units?
items.answer: Yes. Channel-to-sale attribution ties every lead and sale back to the channel that produced it — real sold-unit results, not vanity metrics.

sections.title: Put AI on the night shift.
sections.body: After-hours coverage, no-touch follow-up, magic listings, and channel-to-sale attribution — one platform.
